decision.title: The XSLT API (packet )
decision.summary: include/sxml/xslt.h adds sxml_xslt_stylesheet, compiled from the principal module or through the resolver, with output definitions, one transform call per invocation, result delivery kinds and a result document handler.

body.p: . include/sxml/xslt.h is new, header only, after xquery.h (); 4.15 implements it in src/xslt.c.

item.p: Stylesheet: sxml_xslt_stylesheet (lifecycle quintet, like sxml_xquery_query) compiled from the principal module's bytes, or fetched through the resolver as an XSLT_MODULE (a URI reference) or an XSLT_PACKAGE (name and package-version), chosen by sxml_xslt_principal_module_source. Includes, imports and used packages always come from the resolver (XTSE0165, XTSE3000, XTSE0180). Static parameters are sxml_variable_binding_view values given at compile time (XTDE0050 is then a compile failure with DYNAMIC_ERROR). Of the shared static context only static_base_uri, the default collation and collation bindings are read; namespaces, variable declarations and decimal formats must be empty, since the stylesheet declares its own.

Output definitions: sxml_xslt_output_definition = the parameters struct + (a serialization flag) + has_serialization_method (false: method chosen from the raw result, XSLT 4.0 26.1.2, which serialize.h cannot express). Read by name with sxml_xslt_stylesheet_get_output_definition (0 = unnamed); XSLT's omit-xml-declaration default is filled in as NO, indent stays DEFAULT and means yes for html/xhtml when sxml serializes.

Transformation: one call, sxml_xslt_stylesheet_transform, primes and invokes (one execution scope per call; a primed object for several invocations is left out). The request embeds the shared dynamic context: context value = global context item (one item or absent), variable bindings = stylesheet parameters, trace sink = xsl:message (terminating events end in XTMM9000/XTMM9001 or the given code, ). sxml_xslt_invocation_kind APPLY_TEMPLATES (0; initial match selection defaulting to the global context item, initial mode 0 = default mode, selects_unnamed_mode for the spec's note), CALL_TEMPLATE (name 0 = xsl:initial-template, focus on the global context item), CALL_FUNCTION (arguments by position, arity = count). Template and tunnel parameters are two binding views. Fields are grouped by size (no padding).

Delivery: sxml_xslt_result_delivery DEFAULT (by build-tree), RAW, TREE (sequence normalization, base URI = result URI), SERIALIZED (to an sxml_output_stream); the principal result is the call's output sequence (empty when serialized) and its URI the base output URI.

Result documents: sxml_xslt_result_document_handler with open (request: href, absolute URI against the base output URI, effective output definition, processor; the handler fills a target: delivery and output stream) and close (URI, value, is_abandoned), called once per successful open; XTDE1490 is checked before open, a failing open ( statuses) stops the transformation. The null handler evaluates and discards. Default implementation and test double: sxml_xslt_result_document_collector (quintet; keeps values or bytes by URI, _get_result_document_count, _get_result_document, _clear) for the 4.1 driver's assert-result-document and the WebAssembly host.

Left out, each a later field or function: a primed transformer for several invocations, a context item for the initial template other than the global context item, initial function arguments by name, the stylesheet's parameter list, xsl:message output other than the trace sink, warnings, host extension functions and instructions, schema awareness and streaming ().
